scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build: cd backend && npm install && npm run build
